name: privacy-datamap
description: Read the schemas a repository actually contains — ORM models, migrations, SQL DDL, API contracts — classify the personal data in them against the Fideslang taxonomy, and land the data map in Noru with a citation for every field and a named owner for every judgement.

interface.shortDescription: Build a privacy data map from a repository's schemas
interface.longDescription: Reads the schemas a repository contains, classifies the personal data in them against the bundled Fideslang taxonomy, and lands the result in Noru as a privacy data map. Every field carries the file:line it came from; anything the classifier cannot resolve is raised for a human rather than guessed, and a manifest with unresolved items cannot be pushed.
defaultPrompt: Build a privacy data map for this repository.
What personal data does this codebase hold, and where?
Generate a fideslang manifest for this repo.
